conversations_kind_shape.name: conversations_kind_shape
conversations_kind_shape.value:
("conversations"."kind" = 'dm' and "conversations"."name" is null and "conversations"."dm_key" is not null)
        or ("conversations"."kind" <> 'dm' and "conversations"."name" is not null and "conversations"."dm_key" is null)

conversations_name_len.name: conversations_name_len
conversations_name_len.value: "conversations"."name" is null or char_length("conversations"."name") between 1 and 80

decision_links_title_len.name: decision_links_title_len
decision_links_title_len.value: "decision_links"."title" is null or char_length("decision_links"."title") between 1 and 200

generated.as: to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, title || ' ' || description || ' ' || options_considered || ' ' || objective || ' ' || test_description || ' ' || results || ' ' || outcome || ' ' || reasoning)

decisions_text_len.name: decisions_text_len
decisions_text_len.value:
char_length("decisions"."description") <= 20000 and char_length("decisions"."options_considered") <= 20000
        and char_length("decisions"."objective") <= 20000 and char_length("decisions"."test_description") <= 20000
        and char_length("decisions"."results") <= 20000 and char_length("decisions"."outcome") <= 20000
        and char_length("decisions"."reasoning") <= 20000

decisions_concluded_complete.name: decisions_concluded_complete
decisions_concluded_complete.value:
case when "decisions"."status" in ('decided', 'superseded', 'adopted', 'rejected', 'inconclusive')
        then "decisions"."concluded_on" is not null and btrim("decisions"."reasoning") <> ''
          and (btrim("decisions"."outcome") <> '' or ("decisions"."type" = 'experiment' and btrim("decisions"."results") <> ''))
        else "decisions"."concluded_on" is null end

task_links_title_len.name: task_links_title_len
task_links_title_len.value: "task_links"."title" is null or char_length("task_links"."title") between 1 and 200

tasks_date_range.name: tasks_date_range
tasks_date_range.value: "tasks"."start_date" is null or "tasks"."end_date" is null or "tasks"."end_date" >= "tasks"."start_date"
